import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static int[][] p_array;
    static int[][] pro_array;
    static int[] pop_count_arr;
    static long[][] q_vals_arr;
    static int[] id_map;
    static List<List<Integer>> group_by_pop;
    static Map<Pair, Integer> memo_map;

    static class Pair {
        int idx;
        long state;

        Pair(int idx, long state) {
            this.idx = idx;
            this.state = state;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return idx == pair.idx && state == pair.state;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(idx, state);
        }
    }

    static long fast_power(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int recursive(int idx, long state) {
        if (state == 0) return 0;
        if (idx == n) return 1;
        Pair key = new Pair(idx, state);
        if (memo_map.containsKey(key)) return memo_map.get(key);
        int total = 0;
        int limit = 1 << n;
        for (int subset = 1; subset < limit; subset++) {
            long new_state = 0;
            List<Integer> group = group_by_pop.get(idx);
            for (int k = 0; k < group.size(); k++) {
                if ((state & (1L << k)) == 0) continue;
                int c = group.get(k);
                int nxt = subset - (subset & c);
                new_state |= q_vals_arr[c][nxt];
            }
            long temp = ((long) pro_array[idx][subset] * recursive(idx + 1, new_state)) % MOD;
            total = (int) ((total + temp) % MOD);
        }
        memo_map.put(key, total);
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        p_array = new int[n][n];
        pro_array = new int[n][1 << n];
        pop_count_arr = new int[1 << n];
        q_vals_arr = new long[1 << n][1 << n];
        id_map = new int[1 << n];
        group_by_pop = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            group_by_pop.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        memo_map = new HashMap<>();

        int inv_100 = (int) fast_power(100, MOD - 2, MOD);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p_array[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                p_array[i][j] = (int) ((long) p_array[i][j] * inv_100 % MOD);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                pro_array[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        pro_array[i][j] = (int) ((long) pro_array[i][j] * p_array[i][k] % MOD);
                    } else {
                        pro_array[i][j] = (int) ((long) pro_array[i][j] * (MOD + 1 - p_array[i][k]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            pop_count_arr[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            int popCount = pop_count_arr[i];
            group_by_pop.get(popCount).add(i);
            id_map[i] = group_by_pop.get(popCount).size() - 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 0) {
                    q_vals_arr[i][1 << j] = 1L << id_map[i | (1 << j)];
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                q_vals_arr[i][j] = q_vals_arr[i][j & -j] | q_vals_arr[i][j ^ (j & -j)];
            }
        }

        System.out.println(recursive(0, 1L));
    }
}
